record-classes.title: Record classes
record-classes.why: A record declares its state components and automatically provides a constructor, accessors, equals, hashCode, and toString.
record-classes.tips: Records fit value-like data. Prefer a regular class when the model needs mutable state or a more complex inheritance design.

sealed-classes.title: Sealed classes and interfaces
sealed-classes.short: Restrict which types may extend or implement a type
sealed-classes.why: A sealed type can explicitly limit its permitted direct subclasses or implementations.
sealed-classes.tips: Use sealed hierarchies when the set of variants is intentionally closed. Permitted subclasses must declare final, sealed, or non-sealed.

files-read-string.title: Read a file as a string
files-read-string.short: Use Files.readString for small text files
files-read-string.why: Files.readString provides a concise way to read an entire text file into a String.
files-read-string.tips: For very large files, avoid loading everything into memory and process the input incrementally with a reader.

stream-to-list.title: Convert a Stream to a List
stream-to-list.why: Since Java 16, Stream.toList() provides a concise way to gather stream elements into a List.
stream-to-list.tips: The returned List is unmodifiable. Use a collector or another approach when a mutable List is required.

concurrent-modification-exception.title: ConcurrentModificationException
concurrent-modification-exception.short: A collection was structurally modified during traversal
concurrent-modification-exception.why: Directly changing a collection while an enhanced for loop or iterator is traversing it can be detected as an invalid structural modification.
concurrent-modification-exception.tips: Use removeIf for conditional removal, or Iterator.remove when removing through an iterator.

number-format-exception.title: NumberFormatException
number-format-exception.short: A string cannot be parsed as the requested number
number-format-exception.why: Parsing methods such as Integer.parseInt throw this exception when the input does not match the required numeric format.
number-format-exception.tips: Validate external input and handle parsing failures where malformed data is expected.

unreported-exception.title: unreported exception
unreported-exception.short: A checked exception is neither handled nor declared
unreported-exception.why: Operations that can throw checked exceptions such as IOException require the caller to catch them or declare them with throws.
unreported-exception.tips: Catch an exception where recovery is meaningful; otherwise declare it so a higher layer can decide how to handle it.

non-static-variable-static-context.title: non-static variable cannot be referenced from a static context
non-static-variable-static-context.short: Instance state was referenced directly from static code
non-static-variable-static-context.why: A static method has no particular this instance, so it cannot access an instance field by name alone.
non-static-variable-static-context.tips: Make behavior instance-based when it depends on object state, or explicitly provide the instance whose state should be read.

unchecked-cast-warning.title: Unchecked cast warning
unchecked-cast-warning.short: A generic cast cannot be fully verified at runtime
unchecked-cast-warning.why: Because of type erasure, a runtime cast cannot fully verify type arguments such as the String part of List<String>.
unchecked-cast-warning.tips: Do not merely suppress the warning. Validate element types at the boundary and convert data into a type-safe representation.

mutable-key-hashmap.title: Mutating a HashMap key
mutable-key-hashmap.short: Changing state used by hashCode can make a key unreachable
mutable-key-hashmap.why: HashMap places entries using the key's hash. If state involved in hashCode or equals changes after insertion, lookup can fail even with the same object.
mutable-key-hashmap.tips: Use immutable value objects as map keys and never mutate state that participates in equality after insertion.
